title: Socially Aware Bias Measurements for Hindi Language Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) and Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT) with translated and language-specific word lists to measure associations between male/female words and math/arts, science/arts, and specific adjectives, alongside Meaningful Encoding (ME) tests for grammatical gender.
Using WEAT and SEAT to measure associations between stereotypically upper and lower caste last names with various occupations and polarized positive/negative adjectives.
Using WEAT and SEAT to measure associations of Hindu and Muslim religious terms and culturally distinct last names with positive and negative adjectives.
Using WEAT and SEAT to evaluate perception differences by measuring associations between urban versus rural occupations and polarized positive/negative adjectives.
